fixture_contract.name: optional-fbs-packing-local-isolated
fixture_contract.reset: Fresh local database/schema, tenant/seller/warehouse/supply/order/box fixtures, Redis namespace, Celery queue, emulator namespace and evidence directory per run; frozen clock/seed; worker drain+ack before assertion; teardown receipt after each case; external egress forbidden.
fixture_contract.planned_executor: pytest, Alembic integration runner and local Playwright

coverage.requirement: Fresh exact candidate; no direct old-SHA promotion
Optional journey, durable audit, reload and history
Tenant isolation and independent safety gates
One-tenant CAS and release stop conditions

cases.title: Fresh additive migration preserves defaults and rejects old discovery promotion
cases.fixture: pre-migration tenants and FBS orders; recorded S17 head
cases.fixture_builder: Fresh local pre-migration schema with existing tenant, packed and pending orders
preconditions: S17 supplies current canonical base and Alembic head.
No release candidate SHA exists yet.
cases.adjacent_state: Existing tenants predate the additive revision.
steps: Create the fresh revision from the recorded head.
Inspect heads, defaults and prior rows.
Attempt to register the discovery SHA as candidate.
cases.expected_api: No candidate API may accept the discovery SHA.
cases.expected_authorization: Only controller-issued base may seed the candidate.
cases.expected_transaction: Upgrade is additive and creates one Alembic head.
cases.expected_db: Existing/new tenants read true; existing packed/pending rows retain null bypass reason; no destructive backfill.
cases.read_back: Schema/default and candidate validator show the recorded current head and no old-branch candidate.
cases.reload_assertion: Restarting the old application contract on the new schema remains compatible.
cases.oracle: S11 safe default; S13/S14 fresh candidate and additive migration boundary.

cases.title: Explicit optional tenant bypasses only packing and records durable reason
cases.fixture: eligible packing-pending order, existing physical box, fbs_packing_required=false
cases.fixture_builder: Isolated transaction fixture with no packing task and all independent gates satisfied
preconditions: Tenant flag is explicitly false.
Order is packing-pending and otherwise eligible.
cases.adjacent_state: Operator is in the existing authenticated supply/box flow.
steps: Assign the order to its physical box through the existing path.
cases.expected_ui: The normal next applicable step is available without a synthetic packing action/task.
cases.expected_api: Existing assignment succeeds once and exposes the persisted reason through the existing read model.
cases.expected_transaction: Eligibility, audit and box link commit atomically.
cases.expected_db: pack_status=packed, packing_bypass_reason=tenant_optional, one box link and persisted timestamp.
cases.read_back: API/read model distinguishes tenant_optional from physical packed/null.
cases.reload_assertion: Reload shows the same box membership and automatic-bypass truth.
cases.oracle: S11 approved optional journey and S13 three-state audit model.

cases.title: Required, default, missing and unreadable configuration fail closed
cases.fixture: four otherwise-identical unpacked orders under true, default, missing-tenant and settings-read-error variants
preconditions: Orders remain unpacked.
No variant has explicit false.
cases.expected_ui: Visible safe failure; required variants remain blocked, never shown as automatically packed.
cases.expected_api: order_not_packed for resolved required/default; missing/unreadable setting maps to explicit safe operational error.
cases.expected_authorization: No tenant fallback or inferred false.
cases.expected_transaction: No box link or bypass transition commits.
cases.expected_db: Order stays pending with null bypass reason.
cases.reload_assertion: Reload keeps the blocked state and no synthetic task/completion appears.

cases.title: Bypass audit survives read-back and later flag reversal
cases.fixture: one tenant_optional bypassed order then a fresh pending order after flag is restored true
cases.fixture_builder: Ordered local journey group with approved fixture-only config seam
preconditions: AC02-equivalent bypass is committed.
Configuration reversal is simulated only in isolated fixture.
cases.adjacent_state: Historic order is visible; a new pending order exists.
cases.expected_ui: Historic automatic route remains recognizable; new order shows the existing packing block.
cases.expected_api: Historic read-back retains tenant_optional; new assignment returns order_not_packed.
cases.expected_transaction: No historical rewrite during configuration change.
cases.expected_db: Historic packed/tenant_optional unchanged; new order pending/null.
cases.read_back: Both states remain distinct after API read-back.
cases.reload_assertion: Workspace reload cannot collapse automatic and physical/historical packing truth.
cases.oracle: S11 history boundary and S13 configuration-history journey.

cases.title: Tenant, seller and warehouse predicates prevent cross-scope bypass
cases.fixture: tenant A=false and tenant B=true with distinct orders/boxes; wrong tenant/seller/warehouse requests
cases.fixture_builder: Two isolated tenant graphs and unauthorized request variants
preconditions: Only tenant A is optional.
Orders are unpacked.
cases.adjacent_state: Actor has tenant A session then tries cross-scope objects.
steps: Attempt tenant B and cross-seller/warehouse assignment with tenant A identity.
cases.expected_ui: N/A: API authorization surface only; S25 later owns visible operator acceptance.
cases.expected_api: Only A succeeds; cross-scope request is forbidden/not found and B remains order_not_packed.
cases.expected_authorization: Every order, box and setting lookup retains authenticated tenant UUID and existing seller/warehouse constraints.
cases.expected_db: Only A records tenant_optional and one A box link; B remains pending/null.
cases.read_back: B read-back reveals no A state or audit reason.
cases.reload_assertion: Fresh tenant B read cannot observe A assignment.
cases.oracle: S11 tenant-scoped decision and S14 isolation judgement.

cases.title: Concurrent duplicate assignment and retry produce one durable bypass
cases.fixture: one eligible optional order, one physical box, synchronized two-request barrier and retry
cases.fixture_builder: Transaction fixture exposing the selected lock/conditional-write barrier
preconditions: Flag explicitly false.
Order has no box link and is packing-pending.
cases.adjacent_state: Two identical requests reach eligibility concurrently.
cases.expected_api: One semantic success; duplicate/retry follows existing idempotency response without second effect.
cases.expected_transaction: Lock/conditional write serializes transition and box link.
cases.expected_db: Exactly one box link, one tenant_optional reason/timestamp and no contradictory state.
cases.read_back: Final state is stable and singular.
cases.reload_assertion: Reload shows one assignment and one automatic-bypass audit fact.
cases.oracle: S11 retry rule and S14 concurrency requirement.

cases.title: Optional packing never bypasses marking, cargo-place, delivery or authorization gates
cases.fixture: parameterized optional tenant orders each failing one independent prerequisite
cases.fixture_builder: Isolated fixture variants for marking, cargo-place, delivery preflight and authorization
cases.external_mode: local only; any marketplace effect is mocked/forbidden
preconditions: Flag explicitly false.
Packing is the only gate allowed to be bypassed.
cases.adjacent_state: Order is at the existing relevant preflight boundary.
steps: Attempt the existing journey for each failed prerequisite.
Inspect returned block, audit and assignment state.
cases.expected_ui: Existing visible blocker for the failed independent prerequisite remains; no false progress.
cases.expected_api: Existing prerequisite-specific failure is returned, not a packing success shortcut.
cases.expected_transaction: No forbidden downstream side effect commits.
cases.expected_db: No unsafe assignment/audit transition for blocked variant.
cases.expected_external: N/A; external calls are forbidden or emulated.
cases.read_back: State identifies the original independent blocker, not completed packing.
cases.reload_assertion: Reload preserves the same blocker with no synthetic packing completion.
cases.oracle: S11 boundary that optional packing weakens no independent requirement.

cases.title: Migration head mismatch, second head and destructive rollback stop the release
cases.fixture: recorded-head, stale-parent and second-head graph variants
cases.fixture_builder: Synthetic Alembic graph and pre-existing order rows
preconditions: S17 records one current head.
No live migration is attempted.
steps: Present stale parent and second-head variants.
cases.expected_authorization: Only fresh recorded-head migration is admissible.
cases.expected_transaction: Invalid graph/downgrade is rejected before release progression.
cases.expected_db: Additive columns/audit survive application rollback; no drop/backfill rewrite.
cases.read_back: Validator records exact mismatch reason and resume stage.
cases.reload_assertion: Prior application contract remains usable on additive schema.
cases.oracle: S13 migration boundary and S14 additive rollback judgement.

cases.title: Returning a tenant to required packing blocks only future orders and preserves historic bypass truth
cases.fixture: one tenant_optional bypassed order, one new packing-pending order and fixture-only flag reversal from false to true
cases.fixture_builder: Ordered local journey group with an isolated configuration seam and fresh future order
preconditions: An AC02-equivalent automatic bypass is durably committed while the tenant flag is false.
The fixture reverses only that tenant flag to true; no release or production configuration operation exists.
cases.adjacent_state: Historic automatic bypass and a new unpacked order coexist for the same tenant.
steps: Read the historic bypassed order and capture its audit fields.
Reverse the isolated fixture flag to true.
Attempt assignment of the new unpacked order.
Read both orders and reload the workspace.
cases.expected_ui: Historic order remains visibly distinguishable as automatic bypass; the new order shows the existing required-packing blocker without a synthetic completion.
cases.expected_api: Historic read-back retains tenant_optional; new assignment returns order_not_packed after the flag is true.
cases.expected_authorization: The reversal and both reads remain scoped to the authenticated fixture tenant; no seller, warehouse or other tenant is affected.
cases.expected_transaction: The future assignment is rejected without modifying the historic bypass row or creating a new box link.
cases.expected_db: Historic order remains packed with packing_bypass_reason=tenant_optional and original timestamp; new order remains pending with null reason and no box link.
cases.read_back: Both rows prove that the reversal changes future eligibility only and does not rewrite audit truth.
cases.reload_assertion: Reload preserves the historic tenant_optional fact and the new required-packing blocker as distinct states.
cases.oracle: S11 approved configuration-history boundary; S13 configuration-history journey; S14 durable audit and rollback boundary.

cases.title: One-UUID compare-and-set mutates exactly one verified tenant
cases.process: tenant configuration after exact runtime verification
cases.fixture: two tenants true; runtime SHA/digests equal local immutable manifest
cases.fixture_builder: Sanitized local release packet and database fixture
preconditions: Exact candidate/runtime verification is simulated successfully.
Target UUID is explicit and control tenant is distinct.
cases.expected_api: N/A: no public setting endpoint is added.
cases.expected_authorization: Target is exactly owner-named UUID; no name/seller/warehouse selector.
cases.expected_transaction: Conditional update affects exactly one true row.
cases.expected_db: Target false, control true; sanitized audit has actor/time/candidate/before-after; retry has no broadened mutation.
cases.read_back: Target=false and named control=true immediately after operation.
cases.reload_assertion: Repeated release packet evaluation never changes another tenant.
cases.oracle: S13 CAS boundary and S14 atomic SQL requirement.

cases.title: Ambiguous, zero-row or precondition-failed CAS stops without mutation
cases.fixture: missing UUID, non-UUID selector, target already false, and runtime mismatch variants
cases.fixture_builder: Parameterized sanitized packet and database states
preconditions: No production operation is available.
Each variant violates exactly one release condition.
steps: Inspect affected row count, audit and flags.
Invoke planned rollback simulation after a valid fixture.
cases.expected_transaction: Zero or non-exact-one effect is a release blocker; no read-then-unconditional update.
cases.expected_db: Invalid variants change zero rows; simulated rollback changes only valid target true and preserves bypass audit.
cases.read_back: Flags/audit prove no broadened mutation; blocker carries exact resume condition.
cases.reload_assertion: Re-evaluation after failure remains stopped until corrected input.
cases.oracle: S14 CAS falsification and S13 stop/rollback criteria.

cases.title: Exact candidate and bounded future operator trace reject runtime mismatch and live marketplace side effects
cases.process: exact-SHA release and production trace plan
cases.tenant: future owner-named UUID; local pseudonym in S19
cases.fixture: local immutable manifest, matching/mismatching runtime version and otherwise eligible order
cases.fixture_builder: Local release-controller contract fixture and browser route mocks
preconditions: No owner approval exists at S15.
S23 candidate is unknown; local fixture uses placeholder manifest only.
steps: Inject SHA/digest mismatch and old discovery SHA.
Attempt trace fixture that would call marketplace.
cases.executor_type: pytest release contract plus local Playwright
cases.expected_ui: Local simulation shows normal next step/read-back only; it is not Product Browser approval.
cases.expected_api: Runtime mismatch/old SHA prevents promotion; side-effecting fixture stops before external call.
cases.expected_authorization: S27 requires separate owner approval naming full S23 SHA, manifest and one tenant UUID.
cases.expected_transaction: No tenant mutation occurs before exact runtime verification.
cases.expected_db: Local simulation is isolated; no live data exists.
cases.expected_external: No live WB/Ozon request; an irreversible external side effect is a typed release blocker.
cases.read_back: Matching local fixture retains box/audit state; mismatch records stop reason.
cases.reload_assertion: Local reload is deterministic and never treated as production trace.
cases.oracle: S11/S13/S14 exact-SHA stopper and S28 bounded operator plan.
